about: Touched-path → test-suite map (bothouse#236), read by `botq test-map`. The acceptance gate derives every landed job's touched paths from its own diff and requires the commands mapped here green — independent of the job's brief. First matching rule wins: specific rules above broad ones. `tests: []` means CONSCIOUSLY untested and must carry its why. An unmapped path fails the resolver loud. Commands run from the repo root; lint completeness with `botq test-map --check`.

rules.why: editing the map re-lints its own completeness over every tracked file
the live proof harness — a full run needs a controller, sudo netns and the public relay, so the gate checks syntax only; run `nix-shell --run './demo.sh'` manually when touching it
the pinned dev environment — every cargo command below runs inside it, so a break fails those loudly

the vendored noq-udp patch, the [patch.crates-io] wiring and the lockfile exist for the static musl agent (SPEC property 4, egdod#3) — so besides both native suites, the cross build itself must still produce a binary; nix caches it by input hash
the package's own suite; musl-specific breakage lives in libc-facing deps (covered by the vendor rule), not here
